description: Air, ocean and US / Mexico cross-border truck rates for a shipment with at least one end outside the US / Canada (import, export, or between two other countries). Describe the cargo ONE way: items (pallets / pieces with dimensions), containers (ocean full container load: 20'DV, 40'DV, 40'HC), or volume (total cubic feet when piece sizes are unknown). Returns every option: mode (AIR / OCEAN / TRUCK), service (LCL, FCL, STANDARD, EXPRESS, ...), door service (door_to_door, door_to_port, port_to_door), price, transit days, ports and how long the rate is valid. door_to_port and port_to_door prices do NOT include charges at the far port; tell the user that plainly, and the user must accept those charges before booking. Not served: hazardous materials, sanctioned countries, and pickup and delivery in the same non-US country. Pricing runs live and can take up to a minute; if it times out, retry once. For domestic US freight use compare_modes or ltl_quote instead. Book the user's chosen option with international_book. Requires a signed-in Warp account.

containers.description: Ocean full container load (FCL), up to 30 containers. Use this OR items OR volume.

count.description: Number of containers of this size

city.description: City. Needed outside the US / Canada.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, CN, DE

latitude.description: Latitude, improves pricing outside the US / Canada

zipcode.description: Postal code. Required where the country uses one (see international_settings).

items.description: Pallets / pieces, one entry per group of identical units. Use this OR containers OR volume.

stackable.description: Whether units can be stacked. Defaults to false.
